tasks.short: Set weekly priorities for the 13-person HR team, chase status, approve exceptions, coach direct reports.

steps.what: Collect status from HRBPs, recruiters, payroll and admin by mail and Teams
Weekly priorities and workload review in an Excel tracker and team meeting
Approve escalations: contract changes, pay exceptions, dismissal routes
One-to-ones, coaching and performance talks with direct reports
Write monthly HR update for the management team

loop.input: HR metric extract with month-on-month changes and the director's short notes
loop.check: all figures inserted by code from the metric layer; model text may not contain numbers not in the extract; director reads before sending
loop.stop: one draft plus up to two regenerations; on failure fall back to the fixed template with figures only
loop.why_not_simpler: the explanation of why metrics moved is free text that a template cannot write

tasks.design: Replace the Excel tracker and the status mail round with a Power BI team-workload page fed nightly from AFAS (absence cases, mutations), Recruitee (open vacancies, stage age) and Studytube (overdue certificates), plus Teams notifications when an item breaches its agreed age. Exceptions run through configured AFAS workflow approvals with CAO-table pre-checks, and a small drafting step writes the MT update around code-inserted figures.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status lived in three systems and people's heads; building cross-system views cost more analyst time than the chasing it saved.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS, Recruitee and Studytube all expose APIs and Power BI already holds a nightly AFAS extract; AI-assisted coding makes the joins and alert rules a matter of days.
tasks.still_hard: Case age is a weak proxy for case difficulty; the dashboard will flag slow cases that are slow for good reasons.
tasks.human_edge: Coaching HRBPs, weighing a manager's request against fairness across sites, and carrying accountability for approvals stay with the director.

ambition.what: Re-balance team workload weekly across the three sites instead of at quarterly planning.

tasks.altitude: Less chasing, more time on direct reports; the director gains the right to set which exception types auto-approve within CAO bounds and which always need sign-off.

reach.task: maintain the HR metric layer behind Power BI
reach.learn: how case age and stage age are defined so alert thresholds mean something
which mutation types fail checks most often

evidence.claim: HR platforms let the HR lead set which tasks run alone, which need review and log every approver.
AFAS Profit supports workflow approvals on mutations.
Workload dashboards that show per-person case counts can be treated as employee monitoring and need works council consent.

assumptions: The AFAS extract in Power BI already includes absence cases and mutations.
Recruitee API access is available on the current licence.
unknowns: Whether the OR sees a per-employee workload view as a monitoring system under WOR art. 27.
Which AFAS workflows are already configured for approvals.
How many exceptions per month reach the director today.
research_questions: How many hours a week do the director and team spend on status mail and the tracker?
Can the team-level view be aggregated so no individual HR employee is tracked, avoiding consent?
Which exception types could be pre-approved within CAO tables without legal risk?

tasks.short: Answer managers' policy questions, advise on harassment and equal treatment cases, propose policy changes.

steps.what: Receive manager questions by mail, Teams and phone
Look up policy, CAO article or law and answer routine questions

loop.input: manager question plus retrieved passages from SharePoint policies and both CAOs
loop.output: short answer with cited article and link, or a hand-off to HR
loop.check: answer must cite a retrieved passage; a classifier routes harassment, discrimination, dismissal, medical and pay-dispute topics to a person before any answer
loop.stop: one answer attempt; no citation or low retrieval score means hand-off to the HRBP queue
loop.why_not_simpler: managers ask in free text and the answer lives in long documents; an FAQ page alone has not been used

steps.what: Draft written advice to a manager on a sensitive case

loop.input: director's case notes and the relevant policy passages
loop.output: draft advice with steps, deadlines and cited rules
loop.check: director edits and signs; draft runs on the governed tenant, no special-category data leaves it
loop.stop: one draft, regenerate on request; fallback is the director writing it
loop.why_not_simpler: each case differs; a template covers the structure, not the reasoning

steps.what: Judge harassment, discrimination and conflict cases and talk with the manager
Notice recurring issues and propose policy changes

tasks.design: A Teams policy desk answers routine manager questions from SharePoint policies and the two CAOs with cited articles, discloses that it is an assistant (AI Act Art. 50) and hands sensitive topics straight to the HRBP queue. Every question is logged; a monthly Power BI page shows question themes by site, which feeds policy proposals, and the director drafts sensitive advice with a bounded drafting step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policies and CAO texts were too long and inconsistent for keyword search, and a wrong answer on law carries legal cost.
tasks.enabler_now: Retrieval with forced citation now answers from long documents reliably enough for routine questions, with routing as the safety net.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping SharePoint policies current and consistent; a stale document gives a confidently cited wrong answer.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing both sides in a harassment case, weighing credibility and protecting the reporter cannot be delegated.

ambition.what: Shift leads and team leaders in the Tilburg and Venlo warehouses, who rarely reach HR today, get answers at night and on weekend shifts.

tasks.altitude: Fewer interruptions on routine questions; the director decides which topics the desk may answer and owns the hand-off list.

reach.learn: which escalations the desk should have answered and which it should never touch
how pay questions are phrased so the desk retrieves the right table

evidence.claim: IBM's AskHR handled 16 million messages in 2025 with CSAT +74, after an early failure from removing human routes too fast.
At IBM India 90-95% of HR questions go through an assistant while managers keep decisions.
Chatbots must disclose they are AI under Art. 50 of the AI Act.
AI policy should be discussed with the works council in the Art. 24 meeting.

assumptions: Policies and CAO texts sit in SharePoint in a findable form.
Managers have Teams on their phones or shared terminals.
unknowns: How many manager questions arrive per month and what share is routine.
Whether warehouse shift leads have Teams accounts.
How current the SharePoint policy set is.
research_questions: Of last quarter's manager questions, what share could be answered from a cited policy passage?
Do shift leads in Venlo and Tilburg actually use Teams?
What error rate on a 100-question test set would HR accept before go-live?

tasks.short: Pull HR data, find causes of turnover, absence and hiring problems, recommend policy changes.

steps.what: Request extracts from AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency portals
Combine and clean data in Excel
Drill down by site, shift, manager and agency to find causes
Read exit interview notes and 90-day leaver comments for themes

loop.output: theme label per comment from a fixed list of 10-15 themes, with quote
loop.check: monthly sample of 20 labels checked by the HRBP; themes with fewer than 5 cases hidden to protect identity
loop.stop: one pass per comment; unclear goes to 'other' for manual read
loop.why_not_simpler: comments are free text in Dutch and other languages; keyword rules miss most of them

steps.what: Write recommendations and present to the management team

tasks.design: Extend the nightly AFAS extract into a governed metric layer that also loads Recruitee stages, Studytube completions and agency hours, and publish fixed Power BI pages for the North Star: hire-to-day-90 retention, time to hire, week-one onboarding and verzuim by site, shift and agency. A bounded classification step tags pseudonymised exit comments into fixed themes; the director keeps the reading of causes and the recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Four sources with different employee keys and no analyst time to join them; every question became a one-off Excel job.
tasks.enabler_now: Power BI and the AFAS extract already exist; AI-assisted coding makes the Recruitee, Studytube and agency joins cheap to build and maintain.
tasks.still_hard: Matching flex workers from agency portals to later AFAS hires, and small group sizes per shift that make causes noisy and identities guessable.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding which correlation is a cause, and which recommendation managers and the OR will accept, needs the director's knowledge of the sites.

ambition.what: Review 90-day retention by site and agency every month instead of once a year.

tasks.altitude: From ordering numbers to reading them; the director decides each month which site or agency gets an intervention.

reach.task: build the metric layer and definitions
reach.learn: which drill-downs the director actually uses
how agency choice links to 90-day retention and cost per productive hire

evidence.claim: Personnel analysis is best served by a copilot on the people analyst's metric layer, giving scenarios not one number.
AFAS Profit 8 adds a match score for vacancies; scoring people is high-risk under the AI Act from Dec 2027.
Systems that evaluate or monitor workers become high-risk from 2 Dec 2027.

assumptions: Verzuim data in the extract holds no medical diagnosis, as Dutch law forbids recording it.
unknowns: Whether agency portals carry a stable worker id that matches later AFAS records.
Where exit interview notes are stored and in what form.
Whether the OR must consent to new analyses of absence data.
research_questions: Can flex workers be matched to later direct hires in more than 80% of cases?
Are per-site, per-shift groups large enough to report without identifying people?
Does the existing Power BI licence and AFAS extract support adding three more sources?

tasks.short: Plan the HR year: training, certificates, works council and union agenda, HR budget with Finance.

steps.what: Build the annual HR plan and calendar
Track mandatory certificates (forklift, VCA, food safety) from Studytube exports
Prepare works council and union dossiers, cost CAO demands

loop.input: union demand letters and FNV/CNV publications
loop.output: structured list of demands with parameters (percent, effective date, scope)
loop.check: director confirms each extracted parameter; costing runs in deterministic code on AFAS payroll data
loop.stop: one extraction pass; unclear demands flagged for manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: demands arrive as prose letters; the costing itself is plain code

steps.what: Agree HR and flex worker budget with Finance
Consult the works council and negotiate with unions

tasks.design: Configure Studytube expiry alerts and a Power BI certificate page joined to AFAS rosters so forklift and VCA gaps reach shift leads before they lapse. A Python costing model on the governed data platform prices CAO demands and budget scenarios from AFAS payroll and agency hours, with a bounded extraction step reading union demand letters; the director keeps the plan, the OR consultation and the bargaining.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costing CAO demands meant rebuilding payroll logic in Excel each round, and certificate tracking depended on manual exports.
tasks.enabler_now: Studytube has native expiry reminders; AI-assisted coding makes a reusable costing model affordable, and the 2027 transport CAO round is starting now.
tasks.still_hard: Modelling the pension switch and the in-house warehouse CAO interactions; scenario assumptions remain a judgement call.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust with the OR and unions and choosing what to trade at the table are the director's work.

ambition.what: Same-day costing of any union counter-proposal during the 2027 CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer round.

tasks.altitude: More time at the bargaining table and with the OR; the director decides scenario assumptions and which AI uses go to the OR for consent.

reach.learn: which pay components the costing model must mirror exactly

reach.task: build the annual personnel cost budget
reach.learn: how CAO scenarios flow into the company forecast

evidence.claim: FNV asks for worker say over AI at the CAO table and AI-literacy training.
The transport CAO ends 31 Dec 2026, before the pension switch.
Budgets from AFAS positions and CAO tables suit deterministic software.
Studytube tracks certificates and sends expiry reminders.

assumptions: Studytube certificate records carry expiry dates.
Payroll exports from AFAS contain all CAO pay components.
unknowns: Whether Studytube expiry reminders are already switched on.
Who in Finance owns the flex worker budget today.
Whether the warehouse CAO is negotiated on the same calendar as the transport CAO.
research_questions: Can a costing model reproduce last year's CAO cost within 1% of actual payroll?
How many certificate lapses happened in the last 12 months and what did they cost?
Does the OR want to review the costing model's assumptions before the round?

role.altitude: From running HR services and chasing status to designing how HR works: which questions a policy desk answers, which approvals stay gated, which metrics are reviewed monthly, and what is agreed with the works council and unions about AI.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: own the metric layer the director now reads monthly
HR Business Partner: take escalations from the policy desk and refine its hand-off list
FP&A Analyst: link CAO scenarios and flex worker cost to the company forecast
Payroll Specialist: validate the CAO costing model against actual payroll
skills_to_grow: Setting and auditing gates and logs for automated HR steps
AI Act and AVG literacy, including high-risk classification from Dec 2027
Negotiating AI agreements with the OR and unions
Reading cohort metrics like 90-day retention without over-reading small groups
role.ambitious_version: Noordhaven HR runs on a documented operating system: a cited policy desk for every shift lead, a monthly North Star review by site and agency, same-day CAO costing, and an AI agreement with the OR and unions signed before the 2027 bargaining round closes.
